prior_credit: Published Nov16–18 key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), George Lasry (2017). Earlier repository OCR and the p201 A1 native address reading retain their attribution. Source review, conditional pretransposition-loss model and explicit repairs: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All324 received ciphertext slots remain in printed order. The 324-slot column permutation is applied before adding two missing fractionation coordinates; the receiving ciphertext is never reinterpreted under a326-slot transposition.

The hypothetical forward process fractionates163 labels to326 coordinates, removes two specified coordinates, then transposes the remaining324. Exact reproduction does not establish that this historical mechanism occurred.

The prefix vocabulary and offsets were selected retrospectively. All52,975 two-loss placements and all tied optima are retained in each stated scope; neither a global key search nor unique wording is claimed.
Four observed-coordinate word repairs are separate from two added fractionation fills. No received source slot is excluded, filled or inserted in the primary visible-X branch.
The two overstruck X-like glyphs retain a conservative two-mask alternative. Completing those masks asX in that branch would cost two additional glyph-mask fills; it is not free source evidence.
The reference ending ZT?NRX1?111?X and literal ROEM2 remain unresolved/literal. The eight unknown square labels are globally injective; no historical date or reference number is selected.
